news.title: Anza’s Alpenglow goes live on Solana, cutting finality to 150 milliseconds
news.summary: Solana activated Alpenglow, replacing TowerBFT and cutting transaction finality from 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds.

news.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
news.summary: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Big Tech’s eMudhra fixes may leave crypto bots exposed, CertiK warns
news.summary: CertiK says crypto trading bots and exchange applications may remain exposed to the eMudhra certificate flaw because browser fixes may not protect all software.

news.title: 5 alternatives to Ledger to store your Bitcoin
news.summary: Hardware wallets aren’t the only way to protect your crypto, but from ETFs and passkeys to multisig accounts, each alternative has its own risks and trade-offs.

news.title: Standard Chartered signs definitive agreements to acquire Zodia Custody
news.summary: Standard Chartered has signed definitive agreements to acquire Zodia Custody, subject to regulatory approval.

news.title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers and custody
news.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency’s final rule covers payment stablecoin issuance and some custody activities, with the GENIUS Act framework taking effect in mid-January.

news.title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity
news.summary: Vault12 raised $17.45 million selling VGT in 2018 and says it met or dropped every promise, yet the token has never traded on a centralized exchange.

news.title: Japanese visitors may be able to pay with yen stablecoins in South Korea under Shinhan-SBI pact
news.summary: The collaboration will explore card-linked merchant payments for Japanese visitors in South Korea and peer-to-peer wallet transfers among broader cross-border trade remittances.

news.title: Standard Chartered signs definitive deal to acquire Zodia Custody
news.summary: The signing follows shareholders’ acceptance of Standard Chartered’s non-binding offer in May, with regulatory approvals still pending.

news.title: Dogecoin wallet, app teams unite in push to give DOGE more everyday uses
news.summary: Dogecoin Labs will combine MyDoge, DogeOS and merchant payment tools as developers try to turn coin holders into customers for applications and businesses.

news.title: Dogecoin Labs launches as DOGE ecosystem seeks growth beyond meme-driven demand
news.summary: Dogecoin Labs, backed by the Dogecoin Foundation, unites MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App to push DOGE into payments and DeFi.

news.title: Bitcoin volatility nears 2026 lows as traders brace for Fed decision and US midterms
news.summary: Bitcoin volatility is approaching its 2026 lows, with K33 pointing to weak trading activity ahead of several potential market catalysts.

news.title: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 21, 2026

news.title: First out the gate: OCC debuts final rule implementing Trump-signed GENIUS Act
news.summary: OCC published its final GENIUS Act stablecoin rule, effective Jan. 18, dropping a proposed presumption on third-party rewards arrangements.

news.title: OCC's final rule to start fresh in weighing stablecoin rewards against GENIUS Act ban
news.summary: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency is the first of several federal agencies to finish writing regulations under the act.

news.title: BitGo launches innovation unit to design crypto’s next breakout application
news.summary: BitGo Labs will initially focus on the intersection of AI and crypto, stating that the AI economy needs crypto financial infrastructure.

news.title: PancakeSwap TVL tops $380M as major fee overhaul heads to vote
news.summary: PancakeSwap’s proposed fee-sharing overhaul would give liquidity providers 88% of swap fees and cut CAKE emissions by 69%, as BNB Chain’s DeFi activity expands.

news.title: France proposes liability for crypto exchanges offering DeFi access
news.summary: French authorities want crypto exchanges to conduct checks on DeFi protocols and face liability for certain customer losses under proposed changes to EU crypto rules.

news.title: Bitcoin ‘top buyers’ halt BTC price upside with $87.7K now key: Glassnode
news.summary: Bitcoin price current resistance near $87,000 was reinforced by investors who bought BTC in late 2025, per new research.

news.title: Crypto rises with Asian tech stocks, zcash extends gain after setting upgrade date
news.summary: Bitcoin rose to a one-week high as Asian tech stocks rebounded and SpaceX and Tesla formed committees to explore a merger.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rises to $84,000 as SpaceX leads markets higher
news.summary: South Korea data center player Elice surged 30% after plunging about the same amount following its IPO one day earlier.

news.title: Shinhan, SBI make Japan-Korea tourist spending a test case for yen stablecoins
news.summary: The companies will assess safeguards for travelers and whether stablecoins can speed up trade settlement between South Korea and Japan.

news.title: Zcash rallies 12% as developers finalize NU7 activation height
news.summary: Zcash extended triple-digit year-to-date gains as developers agreed on the NU7 mainnet activation height, targeting Nov. 5, with node synchronization work still pending.

news.title: Drift exploiter sends $109M in Ether to Tornado Cash in 2 days
news.summary: Wallets linked to the $295 million April hack still held $138 million in Ether after sending another $46 million to the mixer Wednesday.

news.title: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger that would unite more than 30,000 bitcoin
news.summary: Independent committees are assessing a potential tie-up, while strong SpaceX earnings lift shares ahead of Tesla’s results.

news.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
news.summary: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

news.title: Tether leads $15 million funding round for AI-focused payment startup Mural
news.summary: The Series A round, which included participation from North Island Ventures and existing investors, brings New York-based Mural's total funding to $28 million.

news.title: Ether ETF outflows continue, pass $1B in October so far
news.summary: US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, while Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed after Monday’s spike.

news.title: Zcash developers confirm November date for upgrade that triples payment speed
news.summary: The NU7 upgrade will cut the time between Zcash blocks to 25 seconds from 75 seconds. The chosen block height still has to be merged into the spec and shipped in node software.

news.title: Malaysia central bank launches DLT platform for tokenized bonds
news.summary: The platform tracks tokenized securities ownership and transfers, linking to Malaysia’s RENTAS+ system to settle corresponding payments in central bank money.

news.title: Ripple brings Wall Street into 24/7 stock bets, but HSBC warns markets are still thin
news.summary: Institutions can trade through Ripple Prime and post RLUSD as collateral. Finding enough buyers and sellers for large positions could prove harder.

news.title: Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites
news.summary: A private key generation flaw allowed anyone to guess them and forge HTTPS certificates for any website.

news.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
news.summary: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

news.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
news.summary: Eight secret keys at eMudhra, an Indian firm that vouches for websites, were compromised. This is a generic, not crypto-specific, risk.

news.title: Bitcoin hovers around $83,000 as AI earnings revive tech, ZEC jumps 11%
news.summary: Strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro sent Asian chip stocks surging, and ZEC led crypto higher after developers set a date for its next network upgrade.

news.title: MoonPay, Upbit parent Dunamu explore collaboration on stablecoin payments, GIWA expansion
news.summary: The companies also plan to explore ways to broaden global access to Dunamu's Ethereum Layer 2, GIWA chain.

news.title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a ‘good idea’ as AI revenue jumps ninefold
news.summary: A merger would bring Tesla into the same corporate group as Grok developer SpaceXAI and social media platform X.

news.title: Qubic restarts blockchain, opens recovery claims after $1.4M hack
news.summary: The network’s validators approved a recovery plan and opened claims until May 1, 2027.

news.title: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
news.summary: Derek Brown likened the prediction market company to a “public nuisance“ that was “causing a significant and substantial ongoing harm“ to state residents.

news.title: U.S. CFTC sets agenda for AI forum, exploring trading and agentic finance
news.summary: A Commodity Futures Trading Commission task force is scheduled for October 28 to talk about how the latest "super intelligence" technology may impact markets.

news.title: Bitwise, Hyperliquid seek SEC rule changes for token trading, airdrops
news.summary: The firms are seeking clearer guidance on the classification of crypto assets and secondary-market trading as the SEC’s public comment period comes to a close.

news.title: Crypto’s 2026 shutdown wave claims 82 projects. What went wrong?
news.summary: Crypto projects are struggling to survive as falling revenues, depleted funding and security breaches force closures across DeFi, blockchain infrastructure and gaming.

news.title: Crypto firms, Wall Street push SEC to revise Regulation Crypto Assets as comments close

news.title: Utah likens Kalshi to a ‘back-alley gambling den’ in lawsuit naming Susquehanna firms
news.summary: Utah seeks to recover alleged gambling profits and block Kalshi bets across sports, politics and culture.

news.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
news.summary: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

news.title: JPMorgan issues first long-term bitcoin return forecast, projecting 10% annually
news.summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management's first long-term bitcoin forecast projects a 10% annual return but flags 55% volatility as a barrier to portfolio adoption.

news.title: Strive closes $630M SATS IPO, leaves Bitcoin allocation unspecified
news.summary: The Bitcoin treasury company could acquire an estimated 7,372 BTC with its net proceeds, potentially surpassing Metaplanet’s holdings if it allocates the full amount.

news.title: Bitcoin yield platform HoneyB developer raises $5 million at $30 million valuation
news.summary: Nectar Group, the developer of bitcoin income platform HoneyB, has raised $5 million in a seed funding round.

news.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
news.summary: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

news.title: Injective, BDACS plan Korean won stablecoin settlement for tokenized assets
news.summary: Injective and BDACS plan to bring won-backed stablecoin KRW1 to tokenized asset markets as South Korea develops a regulatory framework for local currency stablecoins.

news.title: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report
news.summary: Coinbase reports growing adoption by banks and businesses, even as stablecoin market capitalization remains largely unchanged over the past year.

news.title: Ethereum staking hits record as yields fall and Solana activity grows: Bitwise
news.summary: A record 43.8 million ETH, nearly 36% of supply, was staked in Q3 as yields fell to 2.63%. Solana staking hit a record 440.5 million SOL.

news.title: Alphabet, Microsoft add objections to OKX-ICE proposed tokenized stock platform
news.summary: About 25% of the US-listed companies in OKXICE’s initial tokenized stock platform proposal are asking to opt-out of the venture.

news.title: OKX is putting its money where its mouth is with new protection plan: Former NY Gov. Cuomo
news.summary: OKX debuted OKX Shield in the U.S. on Tuesday, in what former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo says is a sign of trust.

news.title: Bitcoin price spikes to $83.3K as US stocks rise on Q3 earnings, oil falls
news.summary: High US corporate earnings reports boosted stock markets and saw BTC price hit $83,300 before reversing at a 21-day trend line.

news.title: Mastercard opens early access to AI agent payments following pilots with Coinbase, Base and Cloudflare
news.summary: Mastercard opened early access to Agent Pay for Machines after pilots with Coinbase, Base, Cloudflare, and other partners.

news.title: Blockchain.com rolls out crypto options as it pursues US derivatives licenses
news.summary: Blockchain.com now offers call and put options on BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, AVAX, XRP and TRX, with expiries up to one week.

news.title: BlackRock seeks to shield bitcoin investors from losses after rival fund weathers 50% crash
news.summary: BlackRock's proposed fund follows similar products from Calamos that helped investors avoid steep losses during bitcoin's selloff.

news.title: Injective partners with BDACS to bring Korean won stablecoin to RWA ecosystem
news.summary: The move comes amid South Korea's regulatory developments to establish a framework for Korean won-denominated stablecoins.

news.title: Kazakhstan court bars Coinbase, five others from unlicensed crypto services in Astana International Financial Centre
news.summary: The court injunctions apply strictly to users within the AIFC and do not extend across the rest of Kazakhstan.

news.title: Stablecoins move over $400 million per hour on average as off-hours transfers dominate, Coinbase and The Block study finds
news.summary: Stablecoins are on track to reach $1.5 trillion in quarterly adjusted transfer volume by the end of 2027 at current growth rates, according to the report.

news.title: Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs join objections to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading
news.summary: Seven more issuers have opted out of being listed on the planned tokenized stock venue under the SEC's framework, bringing its disclosed objection count to 16.

news.summary: Amendment I-3898 removes tax deferral for MiCA-compliant stablecoins starting January 2027.

news.summary: The report marks the first time JPMorgan has put a range on bitcoin returns in its research, though the bank remains cautious about BTC's role in portfolios.

news.summary: Bitcoin slipped 0.5% to around $81,400 even after the biggest daily spot ETF inflow in nearly a month as South Korea's Kospi index fell 3.7% on AI worries.
